datasets.name: Bern data set
datasets.verbatim: All data are derived from publicly available data used for dual-temporal SAR image change detection, and the ground reference images are manually labeled.

methods.name: Unsupervised change detection method through clustering fusion and deep neural networks
methods.summary: The method uses hierarchical fuzzy c-means clustering (HFCM) on log-ratio and neighborhood-based ratio difference images to generate a pre-classification map (changed, unchanged, intermediate). A lightweight deep neural network, featuring decomposition convolution and auxiliary classification modules, is trained using real and virtual samples to reclassify the intermediate class pixels, with a regression layer replacing the standard classification layer for final output.
methods.source: Zhikang Lin, Wei Liu, Yulong Wang, Yan Xu, and Chaoyang Niu
methods.verbatim: Therefore, this paper proposes a novel method for SAR image change detection based on clustering fusion and deep neural networks.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the method is not available.
